title: Australia has announced 50 measures touching its grid supply chain since 2020; the most common: tariffs
subtitle: Industrial-policy measures announced by Australia since 2020 that touch grid supply-chain products, by type (20 support, 30 protection)
notes: Each measure counted once, through 2026. Measures recorded by Global Trade Alert and judged distortive; sanctions excluded. A measure counts here if it covers at least one product in the grid basket.
source: Global Trade Alert; NEIS industrial-policy (NIPO) coding
